talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 114 solo PCPs winding down in Puerto Rico; 22 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Mayaguez 00680, Bayamon 00961, Caguas 00725) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~1,784 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Toa Baja Municipio, Canóvanas Municipio, Peñuelas Municipio) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 17 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~499,200 patients across 416 at-risk practices statewide.
